license_context.PDB_archive: CC0 1.0 Universal per https://www.wwpdb.org/about/usage-policies; raw coordinates, structure factors, CCDs and validation products preserve original author citations.
license_context.original_candidate_release_metadata: Upstream Apache-2.0 and ProtGlycanDock CC-BY-4.0 contexts are preserved in original inventory; source qualification is independent of released benchmark membership.
license_context.primary_articles: Separately licensed publisher/PMC archives; full text/abstract/supplement access scopes remain explicit in primary_paper_evidence.json. No blanket CC0 assertion for articles.

reconstruction: Actual wwPDB weighted coefficient Fourier maps normalized by full-cell sigma, sampling at frozen33point0.5A spheres; no independent re-refinement or newly generated omit maps.
derived_output_rule: Density PNGs and later replay report are outputs rather than experimental replay inputs. Their checksums are recorded separately; report never hashes itself.

derived_replay_report.role: Derived read-only output excluded from its own experimental input inventory.
